name: WHU-HRTCC
description: WHU-HRTCC contains 10,000 paired cloudy and cloud-free RGB remote sensing image patches for high-resolution thin cloud correction. Each sample has a spatial size of 512 × 512 pixels. The dataset is divided into training, validation, and test subsets at a ratio of 7:2:1. Each cloudy image has a spatially corresponding cloud-free reference image. The samples cover five dominant land-cover categories: vegetation, cropland, built-up areas, water bodies, and bare land. Please refer to the associated paper for detailed information on data generation, thin-cloud simulation, scene sampling, and benchmark experiments.
